**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Responsive clauses:** § 28.1 (governing law + forum), § 28.2 (New York County exclusive venue), § 28.3 (escalation — acceptable). No arbitration clause exists anywhere in the document.
- **Problem:** § 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list and in walk-away territory — and directly conflicts with the exclusive New York County venue already conceded in § 28.2.
- **Cure (preferred level, one surgical replace):** § 28.1 now reads "This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York." The exclusive-jurisdiction element was already met verbatim by § 28.2, so no venue language was added and no retained cross-reference is left dangling.
